devin: Quick proposal — setting explicit regression gates for new model bring-up (esp. quantized variants). I sketched a short checklist + numeric pass/fail thresholds. PTAL, want to lock before we start canary next week.

sophia: Nice. Can you add numeric thresholds? e.g., semantic-sim delta, QA F1, hallucination rate, latency p95.

devin: Sure — high level suggestion: 
- semantic_sim (embedding cosine on prompt_set_v2): no more than -1.5% relative drop
- qa_f1 on qa-suite-v4: >= baseline -2pts absolute
- hallucination_rate (human-labeled invented facts/toxic outputs): <= baseline +1%
- p95 latency (inference): <= baseline +50ms
- throughput drop <= 10%
- safety smoke: zero critical safety failures on safety_prompt_set
If any of these fail -> hold rollout and open a triage ticket.

ramon: Couple of quant-specific constraints to add:
- int8-dynamic: acceptable small quality delta but must show >=5% latency or throughput improvement
- 4-bit (PTQ/QLoRA style): require explicit human review on a 500-sample labeled set before canary
- KV-cache correctness check: run `kv-smoke --model <model>` and expect identical next-token behavior for cached prefixes

eva: For automation, CI should run eval_harness and upload artifacts. Example command we should standardize: 
```bash
./eval_harness/run_eval.sh --model=redwood/model:v2-int8 \\  --suite=regression_set_v3 \\  --out=s3://redwood-evals/model_v2/1940001234 \\  --config=eval_config.json
```
CI posts a short summary and upload link. Artifacts must include `predictions.csv`, `metrics.json`, `eval_config.json`, and `seed.log`.

quant-ci-bot: [automated] eval run complete for redwood/model:v2-int8 @1940001256
Summary:
- semantic_sim delta: -0.8%
- qa_f1 delta: -1.1 pts
- hallucination_rate: +0.6%
- p95 latency: -120ms
- throughput: +12%
Decision: PASS (meets all gates)
Full logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/evals/1940001256

devin: Great — bot says PASS. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, auto-escalate to 25% if no alerts. Rollback triggers (within 24h):
- semantic_sim drop > 2% vs baseline
- any critical-task F1 drop > 3 pts
- error rate increase > 0.5% absolute
- safety fail (human flagged)
Who owns the canary monitoring/alerts?

sophia: I will own monitoring. I'll add dashboards: token-level cost, semantic_sim over time, per-route QA F1, safety-fail counts. Alerts: semantic_sim regression (0.75% windowed), safety spike, p95 latency change > 40ms. Manual signoff required before promoting 4-bit variants.

ramon: I'll run the 500-sample human sanity check Monday and attach labels to S3. ETA: EOD Mon. I'll also add a PR checklist for model intake:
- [ ] eval_harness run with `--suite=regression_set_v3`
- [ ] human review on 500 samples (if quant <8-bit)
- [ ] kv-smoke pass
- [ ] latency/throughput bench (p50/p95)
- [ ] console dashboards and alerts configured
- [ ] artifacts uploaded to `s3://redwood-evals/<model>/<ts>/`

eva: One more: capture tokenization/seed and exact eval_config in artifacts for reproducibility. Example `eval_config.json` (attach as literal file):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/model:v2-int8",
  "quant_mode": "dynamic",
  "seed": 42,
  "prompt_set": "regression_set_v3",
  "metrics": ["semantic_sim","qa_f1","hallucination_rate","p95_latency"]
}
```

devin: Excellent. Locking these gates and adding to onboarding checklist. Ramon assigned owner for human review. If no objections I'll add to the intake PR template and ping infra for canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:
